schema:name: Voyager Inn, Davis, California
schema:description: Voyager Inn, Interstate 80, Davis, California. For reservations, write or call 4120 Chiles Rd. (916) 756-2200. A complete Motor Hotel in a garden setting. The Voyager Inn is located on Interstate 80, two miles east of the University of California Campus at Davis, and twelve miles west of the State Capitol at Sacramento. AAA. From the east take Mace Blvd. overpass and proceed one quarter mile to the west. From the west take Mace Blvd exit on your right.
